title: Neurocognitive Modeling of Emotional States Using EEG and Hidden Markov Models: A Multidisciplinary Approach
core_idea: Proposes a multidisciplinary approach that combines EEG-based neural markers (amplitude, arousal, frontal activation, hemispheric asymmetry) with Hidden Markov Models to characterize time-varying, hidden neural states and probabilistic transitions underlying emotional engagement (excitement and love) elicited by multimedia advertisements, and to develop a predictive HMM framework for enabling real-time affect-aware applications in HCI, adaptive learning, immersive media, and BCIs.
tldr: Use EEG plus Hidden Markov Models to model temporal neural states of emotion during ad viewing, aiming to enable real-time affect-adaptive technology.
